exposure: caesarean delivery in the second stage of labour
caesarean delivery in the first stage of labour
Cesarean delivery in the second stage of labor
outcome: Admission to a neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 3,817 women who underwent cesarean deliveries at a tertiary hospital in Istanbul from June 2008 to July 2011
finding: Caesarean deliveries performed in the second stage of labour were associated with higher rates of maternal and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Caesarean deliveries performed in the second stage of labour were associated with higher rates of maternal and neonatal complications, particularly in women who had undergone previous caesarean delivery.
